verdict.rationale: Reclaim says users can chat with an AI Assistant to plan, prioritize and optimize their schedule (reclaim-docs-11). The 2.0 Schedule Assistant acts as a control center that suggests next actions and lets users preview calendar changes before deploying them (reclaim-docs-51, reclaim-docs-52). This covers the core of operating the product through natural language, but the evidence is thin marketing and overview copy. Missing for 10: detailed docs on which actions can be performed by chat (creating or editing tasks, habits, meetings, settings), examples of supported commands, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the chat assistant works as claimed.
